title: High Rainfall Alert
alerts: Heavy rainfall increases the risk of fungal diseases.
recommendations: Monitor field drainage to prevent waterlogging.
Inspect crops for early disease symptoms once weather clears.

title: High Humidity Alert
alerts: Prolonged high humidity creates favorable conditions for blights and mildews.
recommendations: Ensure proper plant spacing for air circulation.
Consider preventative fungicide application if crops are susceptible.

title: Heat Stress Warning
alerts: High temperatures can cause heat stress and increase pest activity.
recommendations: Ensure adequate soil moisture through consistent irrigation.
Consider shading for sensitive crops if possible.
Monitor closely for pest outbreaks like aphids and whiteflies.

title: Strong Wind Advisory
alerts: Strong winds may cause physical damage to tall crops.
recommendations: Delay any foliar spraying until wind subsides.
